subject: Community and Isolation
overview: Medford City Councilor Matt Leming delivered a sermon at the Unitarian Universalist Church of Medford on the relationship between civic engagement, misinformation, and modern social isolation.

items.title: Sermon: Community and Isolation
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming addressed his experiences in local government, examining how loneliness and the decline of community institutions fuel political division and misinformation while urging residents to engage in face-to-face community organizations.
